“Gen Z doesn’t want full-time jobs… they want multiple part-time jobs.”

Yeah… or maybe that’s just what’s available.

In this video, we look at the new buzzword “poly-employment” and why it’s being pushed like it’s some kind of lifestyle choice instead of what it actually is.

In reality working multiple jobs without benefits isn’t really a "trend" is because there's no other choice.

We go through the logic behind this, the job market reality, and what these roles actually look like.

Just adding some context to it.
title: "POLY-EMPLOYMENT!" IS HERE!
